boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, under-21-safe activities around CSU East Bay and Hayward that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: Catch a Recital Hall Concert
cards.subtitle: Free public performances inside CSU East Bay’s Music Building
cards.notes: Check the Music Events calendar, meet outside the north-side entrance, and enjoy a recital without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Hear student, faculty, or guest musicians perform in an intimate campus hall.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay states that all events held in its Recital Hall are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Use the department’s current calendar and confirm the event is in Recital Hall MB1055; University Theatre events follow different ticket rules.

cards.title: Explore Campus at Preview Day
cards.subtitle: Tours, showcases, lunch, and entertainment on the Hayward campus
cards.notes: Register when the form opens, bring prospective-student questions, and follow the event program through campus showcases.
cards.short_summary: Spend an afternoon sampling campus life with family or friends.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay’s October 24, 2026 Preview Day includes campus activities and free lunch, with free event parking.
cards.access_notes: Saturday, October 24, 2026, 10 a.m.–1 p.m.; intended for prospective or admitted students and their families and friends. Registration is expected to open in early fall.

cards.title: Walk the Shoreline Trails
cards.subtitle: Five miles of public gravel trails beside San Francisco Bay
cards.notes: Start at West Winton, stay on signed trails, and bring binoculars for a walk combining bay views and birdwatching.
cards.short_summary: Take a no-fee hike through marshes and former salt-pond landscapes.
cards.evidence_claim: The East Bay Regional Park District lists no parking fee and identifies hiking, bicycling, jogging, birdwatching, and picnicking as shoreline activities.
cards.access_notes: The park is generally open 5 a.m.–10 p.m.; gate hours are 7 a.m.–5 p.m. Stay out of signed restricted habitat, and note that dogs are prohibited south of the West Winton flood-control channel.

cards.title: Cool Off at the Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: A free seasonal water-play space at Cannery Park
cards.notes: Wear water-ready clothes, bring sun protection, and check the seasonal schedule before gathering at the splash pad.
cards.short_summary: Meet friends for an admission-free break beside Cannery Park’s water jets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hayward Area Recreation and Park District lists admission to Cannery Park Splash Pad as free.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operation runs from Memorial Day through Labor Day, with days and hours varying across the summer; check the official page before leaving.

cards.entity_name: Free Outdoor Movie Night at Tennyson Park
cards.title: Watch “Hoppers” Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: A free PG-rated movie night on Tennyson Park’s giant screen
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or low chair, keep flashlights pointed down, and settle in with friends before the film begins.
cards.short_summary: Turn a Friday night into a free outdoor movie picnic.
cards.evidence_claim: H.A.R.D. lists “Hoppers” at Tennyson Park as part of its Free Outdoor Movie Nights series.
cards.access_notes: Friday, August 14, 2026, at 7 p.m. at Tennyson Park, 28377 Huntwood Avenue; bring your own blanket or low-back chair.

cards.title: Climb Aboard Community Vehicles
cards.subtitle: A free hands-on vehicle showcase at San Lorenzo Community Park
cards.notes: Arrive early, explore the driver’s views with your group, and leave room for families moving between the vehicles.
cards.short_summary: See fire trucks, emergency vehicles, and utility equipment up close.
cards.evidence_claim: H.A.R.D. describes Touch-A-Truck as a free hands-on event featuring emergency, police, fire, and utility vehicles.
cards.access_notes: Saturday, August 15, 2026, 9:30–11:30 a.m. at San Lorenzo Community Park, 1970 Via Buena Vista, San Lorenzo. The official page offers an optional place-saving link.

cards.title: Try Agricultural Day Activities
cards.subtitle: Free hands-on learning with local agricultural groups at Meek Park
cards.notes: Gather classmates for demonstrations and hands-on stations, then explore the park between scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: Connect farming history with present-day agricultural work through public activities.
cards.evidence_claim: H.A.R.D. identifies Agricultural Day at Meek Park as a free, family-friendly event with hands-on learning.
cards.access_notes: Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10 a.m.–2 p.m. at Meek Park, 240 Hampton Road, Hayward.

cards.entity_name: Music at the Mansion: The JC Smith Band
cards.title: Lounge at Music at the Mansion
cards.subtitle: Free blues and soul on the Mt. Eden Mansion lawn
cards.notes: Reserve a free spot if requested, bring lawn-ready seating, and enjoy the concert without using the paid donor area.
cards.short_summary: Spend a Sunday afternoon listening to live blues and soul outdoors.
cards.evidence_claim: The event page states that admission to the September 13 Music at the Mansion concert is free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Music at the Mansion Feat. The JC Smith Band
cards.access_notes: Sunday, September 13, 2026, 1–5 p.m. at Mt. Eden Mansion, 2451 W. Tennyson Road. General admission is free; avoid the optional $50 donor circle and optional food purchases.

cards.title: Tour the Airport Open House
cards.subtitle: A free annual aviation event for visitors of all ages
cards.notes: Check the city calendar for the September date, arrive with aviation questions, and explore the public displays together.
cards.short_summary: Get a ground-level look at local aviation during Hayward’s annual open house.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hayward says its annual Airport Open House features all-ages entertainment with free admission and parking.
cards.access_notes: The city identifies this as an annual September event but does not publish the 2026 date on the cited page; verify the community calendar before attending.

cards.entity_name: H.A.R.D. Holiday Lights at McConaghy House
cards.title: Walk Through Holiday Lights
cards.subtitle: A free seasonal open house at historic McConaghy House
cards.notes: Meet at the historic house, walk through the light display, and join the included activities without planning a purchase.
cards.short_summary: Pair a winter lights walk with a free historic-house open house.
cards.evidence_claim: H.A.R.D. lists Holiday Lights as a free event with mansion lighting, activities, an open house, and hot chocolate.
cards.access_notes: Wednesday, December 2, 2026, 5:30–7:30 p.m. at McConaghy House, 18701 Hesperian Boulevard, Hayward.
